purpose.title: Comment purpose
purpose.question: Classify the role of this comment in the supplied surrounding code. Prefer constraint when it contains a meaningful invariant or protocol requirement. Licences and tooling directives are protected. Classification does not authorize deletion.

criteria.constraint: Explains a non-obvious invariant, protocol requirement, mathematical fact, or other checkable constraint.
criteria.documentation: Provides useful public-interface or usage documentation.
criteria.redundant: Only restates behavior already obvious from the supplied code.
criteria.historical: Only narrates previous edits or development history.
criteria.decorative: Only separates or decorates code sections.
criteria.protected: Is a licence, mandated notice, generated-file marker, or tooling directive.
criteria.unsure: The evidence is ambiguous, mixed, or does not support a reliable choice.
